name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
September 9, 2014
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Sister Maureen Brown, St. Thomas More Catholic Church
Recommended Action:
Sister Maureen Brown, St. Thomas More Catholic Church *3
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation Declaring September 10, 2014, to be "Carol Weise Herrera Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of her Vista Education Foundation Educator Lifetime Achievement Award.
P2.
Proclamation Declaring September 11, 2014, to be "Russell Wilson Day" in the City of Vista, in recognition of being chosen as the Boys & Girls Club of Vista California State Youth of the Year.
P3.
Proclamation Declaring September 2014 "National Preparedness Month" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Conflict of Interest Code Biennial Review (CC/BSD/SA)
1.
Adopt the following resolutions amending the list of designated employees subject to the provisions of the Conflict of Interest Code:
a.
City Council Resolution No. 2014- ; and
b.
Successor Agency Resolution No. 2014- .
2.
Direct the City Manager/Executive Director/District Manager to sign, and the City Clerk/Secretary/Clerk of the Board to file, the 2014 Local Agency Biennial Notices for the City of Vista, the Successor Agency to the Vista Redevelopment Agency, and the Buena Sanitation District.
DISCUSSION
PUBLIC HEARING
PH1.
Appeal of Special Use Permit (SUP) for Dollar General at 1234 N. Santa Fe Avenue (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an appeal of Planning Case No. 8-262, a request for an SUP for a bargain basement store and the off-site sale of beer and wine at 1234 N. Santa Fe Avenue.
2.
Adopt the following City Council Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2014- , granting an SUP for a bargain basement store, Dollar General; and
b.
Resolution No. 2014- , denying an SUP for the off-site sale of beer and wine for Dollar General.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
